articles.title: China’s chip supply chain ‘safer’ as self-sufficiency push gains traction, says top planner
articles.summary: China's semiconductor supply chain has achieved significant advancements in self-sufficiency, as reported by the nation's top economic planner, indicating a shift from isolated innovations to a cohesive industrial ecosystem, which is crucial in mitigating the impacts of US export controls. This progress not only enhances national security but also positions China as a formidable player in the global semiconductor landscape.

articles.title: China’s CXMT posts massive 870% revenue surge as ‘aggressive expansion’ pays off
articles.summary: ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) has achieved an astonishing 870% revenue increase, reaching 150.31 billion yuan, following its recent blockbuster IPO, solidifying its position as China's leading DRAM manufacturer and marking a significant milestone in the country's semiconductor industry. This breakthrough not only underscores the effectiveness of CXMT's aggressive expansion strategy but also highlights China's growing dominance in the global tech landscape.
